ruling.author: Ben
ruling.scope: R2 Phase B ruling: 'the spine receipt must become the kernel receipt and honor the same process and claims'; 'ship v2'; and full permission to push onwards. This covers the CI caller update, the producer-derived demo captures, and the installed-tree generator assertion required to replace seal.spine/v1 with seal.receipt/v2. The pre-landed judge, vectors, route-agreement test, v2 specification, and published-asset anchor are unchanged.
